acceptance_criteria.description: The command joins declarations, collaboration status, run links, and verified reports into deterministic experiment and metric views without a hand-edited index.
Metric values are emitted only after standalone verification and report or manifest mismatches fail closed.
The documented workflow keeps one experiment bundle per branch or PR and leaves BMP protocol files unchanged for experiment-only work.
The ledger has stable JSON and CSV output suitable for GitHub artifacts and downstream analysis.

objective: Add a deterministic read-only experiment and metric ledger derived from experiment bundles, immutable lab run links, BMP declarations, and standalone-verified report bytes without introducing a hand-edited global progress board or changing BMP execution semantics.
title: Generate the repository-wide experiment ledger
